scope: Phase pilote Chamagnieu V18 - arbre realiste Web et haie/buisson realiste

poly_haven.evidence: Poly Haven states that all its HDRIs, textures and 3D models are CC0; commercial use and redistribution are allowed and attribution is not required.

blenderkit_cc0.evidence: The official BlenderKit license page describes CC0 as no rights reserved; each shortlisted BlenderKit asset page and API record explicitly reports cc_zero.

blenderkit_royalty_free_public_glb_polic.reason: The official FAQ allows games only when assets are not easily extractable. A public GLB is directly extractable, so Royalty Free candidates are not shortlisted for this Web viewer.

tree.name: island_tree_02_web.glb
tree.comparison_note: Technically efficient and genuinely PBR, but the windswept coastal silhouette is less representative of a suburban garden in Chamagnieu. Retain as verified fallback and possible variation.

hedge.name: shrub_03_web.glb
hedge.comparison_note: The source is low meadow groundcover rather than a hedge. Stretching and repeating 108 clumps creates visible repetition and nearly 0.9 million displayed triangles. Retain only as constrained-device fallback.

tree_candidates.name: Decorative Urban Tree
tree_candidates.author: Davide Tirindelli

download_automation.evidence: Official API: isFree=true, canDownload=true and official download endpoints are present; BlenderKit's official add-on supports free no-login downloads.

tree_candidates.web_quality_assessment: Best fit: upright 6.24 m urban/garden tree, strong silhouette and close-view detail with only 29,641 provider faces. The stock GLB is too large, but the 1K Blend is compact enough to re-export as a self-contained optimized GLB after removing unused ground/material data.
optimization_required: Import 1K Blend rather than 146.99 MB stock GLB
Remove unused concrete/marble/ground objects and materials
Preserve leaf alpha/translucency and normal/roughness information
Export embedded-texture GLB and validate actual triangle count

tree_candidates.name: Tree Small 02
tree_candidates.author: Rico Cilliers

download_automation.evidence: Official files API exposes direct per-file URLs, MD5 values and byte sizes without a paid account.

tree_candidates.web_quality_assessment: Excellent small-garden silhouette and detailed bark/branches/leaves, but the original geometry is 4.65 million triangles. It is the high-detail source behind the BlenderKit urban derivative and is redundant for the pilot unless the derivative fails visual QA.
optimization_required: Resize essential PBR maps to 1K or selective 2K

tree_candidates.name: Jacaranda Tree
tree_candidates.author: Rico Cilliers - all; Rob Tuytel - guidance

download_automation.evidence: Official files API exposes direct per-file URLs, MD5 values and byte sizes without a paid account.

tree_candidates.web_quality_assessment: Realistic mature broadleaf form and relatively moderate published triangle count, but the 24 m crown is much larger than the current planting and the 1K glTF package is 214.61 MB. Consider only for a distant mature-tree variation after scale and botanical fit review.
optimization_required: Check whether scaling preserves believable branch and leaf proportions
Reduce geometry and unusually large binary payload

tree_candidates.name: Island Tree 01
tree_candidates.author: Rob Tuytel - scanning, processing; Rico Cilliers - cleanup, processing

download_automation.evidence: Official files API exposes direct per-file URLs, MD5 values and byte sizes without a paid account.

tree_candidates.web_quality_assessment: Very realistic scan but repeats the same coastal/windswept visual language as the current Island Tree 02 while being much heavier. It does not solve the style mismatch.

hedge_candidates.name: Shrub
hedge_candidates.author: Blendkit Community

download_automation.evidence: Official API: isFree=true, canDownload=true and download endpoints are present; free assets can be obtained with the official add-on without login.

hedge_candidates.web_quality_assessment: Best hedge pilot source: a believable 1.25 m lush garden shrub with only 15,980 provider faces, leaf transparency and a 1.33 MB 1K Blend. It can form an irregular hedge using rotation/scale variants with substantially fewer logical clumps than the current 108-clone setup.
optimization_required: Export a self-contained GLB from the 1K Blend
Bake/convert Blender-only shader nodes to Web-compatible PBR alpha materials
Use GPU instancing and deterministic variations
Target <= 1.5 MB and <= 30k triangles per source mesh

hedge_candidates.name: Shrub 02
hedge_candidates.author: Rico Cilliers

download_automation.evidence: Official files API exposes direct per-file URLs, MD5 values and byte sizes without a paid account.

hedge_candidates.web_quality_assessment: Efficient ready-to-download glTF package and a naturally irregular 5.34 m silhouette. It can cover long hedge segments with fewer instances, but its sapling/groundcover form is less hedge-like and needs careful cropping/scale rather than uniform stretching.

hedge_candidates.name: Shrub 04
hedge_candidates.author: Rico Cilliers

download_automation.evidence: Official files API exposes direct per-file URLs, MD5 values and byte sizes without a paid account.

hedge_candidates.web_quality_assessment: Glossy natural leaves and useful local variation, but the 0.75 m branch cluster costs 47,813 triangles and would require many repetitions to build a complete hedge. Better as sparse filler mixed with the primary shrub, not as the sole hedge asset.

screened_not_shortlisted.name: Tree LOD 2
screened_not_shortlisted.reason: The public Web GLB would be directly extractable; the official BlenderKit FAQ conditions game use of Royalty Free assets on them not being easily extractable.

screened_not_shortlisted.name: Wild Alpine Shrub Evergreen
screened_not_shortlisted.reason: Free does not equal CC0; public raw-model redistribution/extraction remains unsuitable without a separate written license review.

screened_not_shortlisted.name: Realistic Tree
screened_not_shortlisted.reason: The official page marks it Full Plan; it is not an eligible free automated pilot asset.

screened_not_shortlisted.name: Shrub 01
screened_not_shortlisted.reason: Its slender flowering groundcover is only about 0.4 m high and is much heavier than the selected hedge candidates.

tree.fallback: Keep island_tree_02_web.glb unchanged until live A/B validation passes
tree.acceptance_gate: After download: verify 1K Blend provenance, actual textures, scale 6.24 m, <=45k triangles, <=5 MB embedded GLB, no console/network errors and visibly more appropriate silhouette in the LIVE WEB VIEWER.

hedge.fallback: Keep shrub_03_web.glb for constrained devices until live A/B validation passes
hedge.acceptance_gate: After download: export Web-compatible alpha PBR, measure triangles, target <=1.5 MB source GLB, use GPU instancing, reduce visible repetition and prove 30 FPS minimum in the LIVE WEB VIEWER.

pilot_selection.secondary_variation: Use Poly Haven Shrub 04 only as sparse filler if the primary hedge still repeats visibly; do not use it alone for all 18 segments.
